title: STAR FORGE server pack
description: pack.json at the root of a STAR FORGE server pack. Paths are relative to the pack folder and use forward slashes.

format.description: Pack format version. The launcher refuses formats newer than it understands.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier, ideally a reversed domain you control. Used to recognise the pack when it is updated; never change it after release.

version.description: Pack version (semver). Bump it on every release so players see an update.

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the pack card.

links.description: Buttons shown on the play screen.

launcher.description: Minimum STAR FORGE Launcher version, e.g. "0.2.0".

game.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the win64/game.exe builds this pack was made for. The launcher warns players whose game.exe matches none of them.

address.description: Master server host:port written to data/address.cfg. Omit to leave the game's own setting alone.

local.description: Also start the game's bundled local server (MongoDB + Hub). Leave false for remote servers.

branding.description: Look of the launcher while this pack is selected. Every entry is optional; missing ones fall back to STAR FORGE defaults.

logo.description: Wordmark on the play screen. Transparent PNG, about 690x246.

icon.description: Square emblem for the pack list and rail. Transparent PNG, 256x256.

background.description: Play screen art: one image, or a list the launcher picks from at random each time it starts. JPG/PNG/WebP, at least 1920x1080, up to 8 MB each; the right side stays visible.

accent.description: Accent colour for buttons and highlights.

patches.description: Experimental. How the patchsets in the pack's patches/ folder (every patches/<module>.patchset.toml, same format the STAR FORGE Patcher builds for servers) and native plugins are applied.

method.description: How patches are applied. "inject": the agent DLL patches the game in memory before it runs (the only method so far).

on_error.description: When a required patch doesn't match the installed game: "exit" refuses to start the game, "continue" starts it with whatever applied.

plugins.description: Native DLLs in patches/ loaded into the game after patching, for hooks byte patches can't express. They may export int starforge_plugin_init(const PluginApi*). Players are warned that these run native code.

update.description: Where the launcher checks for new versions: the URL of your published pack.json (the copy with download filled in). Unsigned packs installed from a published pack.json get this set automatically; signed packs must set it themselves.

min_version.description: In the published pack.json: the oldest pack version your server still accepts. The launcher won't start the game with anything older until the player updates.

download.description: Only in the published pack.json: where the pack's zip is and its SHA-256. The launcher refuses a download that doesn't match.
